note: Held-out paraphrase/boundary cases for S5.1-a2, separate from the frozen 23-case suite so prompt overfitting is distinguishable from real routing. Every prompt here deliberately avoids the wording used in tools/slm/system_prompt.txt and ledger_tools.json (the frozen suite reuses some of it). Labels are fixed before the run and are never edited to match model output; date placeholders are substituted by tools/slm/slm_eval.py.
